subject: home humidifier
title: What If You Never Cleaned Your Humidifier?

scenes.text: What if you never cleaned your humidifier? It would still add moisture. Just not only moisture.
Within days, bacteria and fungi grow in the tank's standing water. The EPA says clean it every third day.
Cool mist models, ultrasonic and impeller, are very good at throwing whatever is in that water into the air.
That includes minerals from tap water, which settle on furniture as a fine white dust.
US safety regulators warn breathing dirty mist can cause problems from flu-like symptoms to serious lung infection.
Doctors even have a name for one lung inflammation it can cause: humidifier lung. From a machine meant to help.

description:
What if you never cleaned your humidifier? The US EPA says microorganisms grow in tanks of standing water and that ultrasonic and impeller models can disperse microbes and minerals into the air, leaving white dust.
The CPSC warns that breathing dirty mist can cause problems from flu-like symptoms to serious infection, and humidifier lung is a recognised form of hypersensitivity pneumonitis.
